title: Fix: hero overlay uses Tailwind opacity modifier on custom utility (from stanlee-8u7.3)
description: Review of stanlee-8u7.3 found: hero-section.tsx line 16 uses `bg-maroon absolute inset-0 opacity-50` — a Tailwind `opacity-50` modifier applied to the custom `.bg-maroon` utility. This works today but is fragile: the overlay opacity is controlled by a separate Tailwind utility rather than the purpose-built `.bg-maroon-deep/50` utility that was specifically tuned for the forest retheme (stanlee-8u7.2). title: Fix: text-cream/50 and text-cream/40 utility names misrepresent actual opacity values (from stanlee-8u7.2)
description: Review of stanlee-8u7.2 found: the opacity tuning commit (516ca28) bumped .text-cream/50 to 55% and .text-cream/40 to 45% for readability, but left the CSS selector names unchanged. The class names `.text-cream\/50` and `.text-cream\/40` now encode false opacity values — a developer reading the class name expects 50%/40% alpha but gets 55%/45%. This is a naming/semantic contract violation that will cause confusion on future edits. Evidence: app/globals.css lines 237-244 — .text-cream\/50 { color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--pathfinder-cream) 55%, transparent); } and .text-cream\/40 { color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--pathfinder-cream) 45%, transparent); }. Fix options: (a) rename selectors to .text-cream\/55 and .text-cream\/45 and update all component usages, or (b) revert values to 50%/40% and accept the original contrast and document the decision.
